name: Agent report · remote identity fixes
source:
# Full team identity for agent lookup (#13693)

Branch frontend-13693, revision d77eb7932, on approved prerequisite #13692 b88e09a64 (v2.0.53 base). Targets v2.0.55.

liveAgentOf scopes running rows by sessionTeamKey when a board is provided, before either the session hint or case-insensitive role lookup. Bare team keys denote this computer's team; composite keys retain the remote computer. Board export filters the merged session inventory by the full team key before finding a selected subscriber's role, so another team on the same computer cannot contribute its chat. Task assignee lookup scopes rows with inTeam (which uses sessionTeamKey) before checking session id or name; unrelated standalone agents are no longer fallbacks.

A caller audit found that comments and Inbox data hold bare board plus separate server. Comment author/avatar and Sent-to links, Inbox review/question sender links and proposal authors now construct their boardTeamKey before invoking the matcher. Board chat already supplies its composite board key and needs no change. Without qualifying these callers, a correct matcher would still receive the wrong local identity; a real remote comment Sent-to regression proves that failure. The artifact_comment_ask.js import/link change overlaps #13687's file, but not its refresh behavior. Orchestrator confirmed Hub Lead will keep both during integration.

Five node regressions: role collisions across local, m1, m2 and another m1 board; foreign session hint; actual export chat fetch path; rendered task Assigned-to link click and no unrelated fallback; real comment Sent-to link identity. The four original cases fail on the prerequisite, then pass after the core changes. The Sent-to case fails until the caller's computer is retained. Tests use real exported workflows and stub network responses; they do not compare implementation source.

Orchestrator's added compatibility case: the self-hosted Hub's bare dev team mounts goal comments with server local even while selectedTeam is @m2/dev, and listComments requests /api/artifacts/goal:dev:5/comments?state=all&board=dev. It passes; remote mount cases remain green.

Validation at d77eb7932a21a6c315c49b44e227d84e72efd8c3: identity node 5/5; goal-comment node 4/4 including own-Hub case; agent_name_link_browser PASS 1/1 in 2.3s, no retries; full npm --prefix tests/frontend run test:cloud exit 0; go test ./pkg/frontend PASS 18.213s; git diff --check clean. Source pushed; Mac slot released. No backend route, template, CSS or generated markup change. Broader integration remains the v2.0.55 batch gate.
